{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Display basic info about the dataframe
trial_df.info()

# Display the first few rows to understand the structure
display(trial_df.head())

# Check for missing values
print("Missing values per column:")
print(trial_df.isnull().sum())

# Check for duplicates
print(f"Number of duplicate rows: {trial_df.duplicated().sum()}")

# Check the unique values in the 'arm' column
print(f"Unique values in 'arm': {trial_df['arm'].unique()}")

# Check the unique values in the 'response' column
print(f"Unique values in 'response': {trial_df['response'].unique()}")

# Check the distribution of 'response' in the TREATMENT arm
print("\nResponse distribution in TREATMENT arm:")
print(trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'TREATMENT']['response'].value_counts(dropna=False))"}
